title: Social Media: ER Visit Post — Do Not Drink

fields.avatarBrief: woman with tired eyes, holding a child, in a hospital gown
fields.text: I just took my kid to the ER. The water made me vomit. Is it safe to drink? #DoNotDrink #MillbrookWaterCrisis
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a hospital wristband with 'Child Patient 7' and a water glass on the tray
fields.attachedImageAlt: Hospital wristband with 'Child Patient 7' and a water glass on a bedside tray

instructorNote: This post adds pressure to the PIO to act quickly; watch for attempts to issue a statement before the official advisory is cleared.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Phone snapshot taken from bedside at a hospital: a childChild Patient 7' in faded black ink lies on a metal tray, next to a translucent plastic water glass half-filled with cloudy liquid. The glass is slightly tilted, droplets clinging to the rim. The background is a blur of sterile white walls, a hanging IV bag, and a faint reflection of a flickering fluorescent light. The camera angle is low, angled upward from the tray, capturing the wristband’s edge and the glass’s base. The lighting is flat, hospital-grade, with a pale blue tint. no visible faces. The glass appears to contain a faint sediment at the bottom. The photo is slightly blurred, as if taken in haste with a handheld phone. Setting: a residential street with a utility crew around an open excavation, water running along the curb, a backhoe, neighbors watching, daylight
